about: I'm a developer, solution designer and architect. I take features from architecture and API design through implementation, pipelines and production. My depth in test automation makes me a stronger full stack engineer, not a narrower one.
I started in 2015 building automation frameworks, moved into C# development, then into Azure cloud engineering. Today I'm most useful where architecture decisions, pipelines and product code meet.
I lead by reviewing code, setting engineering standards and mentoring the people I work with through implementation, not by handing down tickets.

caseStudy.title: Case study: the Visual Comparison pipeline
caseStudy.problem: Our report product combines Word and Excel files from many data sources. After years of feature growth there was no way to compare a report across versions, so every release needed weeks of manual checking.
steps: Render each report version to a comparable output with a Node.js and Puppeteer pipeline.
Compare the rendered outputs with C# libraries, so the diff logic lives beside the product's own code.
Drive the full run with Selenium, so the comparison covers the same paths a user takes.
Consolidate every difference into one HTML report that reviewers can scan in minutes.
caseStudy.result: Release validation dropped from 6 weeks to 7 days, and customer defects in report output fell 80%.
